title: Geometric probability of a wall-MSSI topology with a 12 keV Compton scatter 27 cm inside the TPC: a photon-transport Monte Carlo
question: What fraction of MSSI-producing gamma histories (one 8-16 keV Compton deposit in the FV plus 60-95 keV in the wall dead shell or 150-260 keV in the RFR, nothing else active) place the FV deposit >= 25 cm from the wall and >= 20 cm above the cathode, for detector-component gammas (352-2615 keV from wall/bottom/top/cathode) and bulk 214Pb beta+gamma, and what does this do to P004's required wall-MSSI mismodelling factor?
headline_result: A weighted photon-transport MC of the LZ TPC finds the 12 keV wall-MSSI class falls as exp(-d/4.3 cm) from the FV edge: f_pos = 0.98% (0.16-1.7% by source, <= 5% with 25% longer attenuation lengths) at the event's position class, i.e. 1.7e-6 (2.7e-7-2.9e-6) expected events and k_required(10%) = 6.4e4 (>= 1.6e4 in every variant) vs k < 1.64 allowed; P004's f_pos range 1e-4-0.12 narrows to 0.002-0.03
key_numbers: f_pos(wall12) 0.0098 equal mix; wall 0.014, top 0.017, bottom 0.0018, cathode 0.0016; per line (wall) 609: 0.0022, 1.1-1.5 MeV: 0.008-0.015, 2615: 0.026; 214Pb 7e-4; lambda_eff 4.2-4.4 cm; 42-46% within 2 cm of FV edge, 85% within 7 cm, edge/event density ratio 70-140; variants (1461 keV) mu x0.8 -> 0.033, isotropic 0.012, shell 1.1 mm 0.014 (rate x0.43), stand-off 10.7 cm 0.040 (rate x0.44); theta(12 keV) 6.4/4.4/2.4 deg and P_KN(8-16) 0.96/0.55/0.24% at 1000/1461/2615 keV; lambda 2.8/6.3/7.7/9.1 cm at 352/1000/1461/2615 keV; N_pos 1.65e-6 (LZ 0.0048 x f_nb 0.035 x f_pos), 2.5e-6 with own energy fraction 0.053; k_req 6.4e4 (3.7e4-3.9e5), k_req/k_allowed 3.9e4; RFR class 6.8x wall overall, f_pos 0.0021, 81% at z<20 cm, RFR/wall at event 1.5 (bottom gammas 104), LZ-normalised 1.4e-8; total MSSI at position class ~2e-6; validation pulls +0.5/-1.1/-1.0/+0.6 sigma, detER-normalised wall MSSI 0.0055 vs LZ 0.0048, 214Pb 0.0038; RFR ROI over-predicted x100 in simplified FV (73-81% in bottom corner d<18, z<20 cm)
model_or_mechanism: vectorised weighted photon transport in a 72.8 x 145.6 cm LXe cylinder with 3 mm dead shell, 13.75 cm RFR and simplified FV; exact Klein-Nishina (Kahn sampling), recalled photoelectric/pair coefficients; survival biasing, depth-uniform forced FV collision, forced 8-16 keV deposit with KN weight, dead-region splitting, Russian roulette; sources wall/bottom/top/cathode planes (Lambertian) and bulk 214Pb beta+gamma; normalisation via LZ wall-MSSI 0.0048 x f_nb 0.035 and via detector-ER 8.5 events
stance: supports DM interpretation (weakly, by elimination of the wall/RFR-MSSI position hypothesis only)
confidence: high for the depth profile and f_pos (robust to source, line, angular distribution, shell thickness; validated against analog transport); medium for absolute rates (recalled attenuation data, x2-3 bracket)
